title: Asla Park, Mossel Bay (Dunjwa St, approx.): man, 19, stabbed dead, 4 Oct
summary: Southern Cape police say officers found a 19-year-old with a stab wound to the chest at a scene in Dunjwa Street, Asla Park, Mossel Bay, on 4 October; paramedics declared him dead. Police allege he was hurt during an alt...
story: Southern Cape police say officers found a 19-year-old with a stab wound to the chest at a scene in Dunjwa Street, Asla Park, Mossel Bay, on 4 October; paramedics declared him dead. Police allege he was hurt during an altercation with a group. No arrests had been made (Mossel Bay Advertiser, 13 October). One source only.
location_note: Dunjwa Street, Asla Park, KwaNonqaba, named by police. The pin is on that street; the exact spot was not given.
